changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 9, item 1: split service/agent/'s dependency-cruiser layer placement into a store tier (folded into service-primitives), a service tier (positioned before service-mid, since workflow-service/scheduler legitimately depend on it), and a collection tier (kept after service-mid); moved CreateLockedTeammateOptions to service-types.ts and service/channel-submission.ts into service/agent/. Internal reorg only; no runtime or published-API change.
